result.summary: The page is largely intact and functional. Only minor visual inconsistencies were found: the delivery fee amount uses an ambiguous decimal separator, and one restaurant thumbnail in the carousel has a noticeably different image treatment from its neighbors.

issues.description: The delivery fee badge reads "€0.90 delivery", with the decimal point rendered as a raised mid-dot-like mark that makes the price look like "€0 90".
issues.suggestion: Render the decimal separator consistently as a standard period so the amount is read correctly as €0.90.

issues.description: The "Smash Bros Burgers" card in the "Fastest near you" row has a noticeably darker, blurred photo than the neighboring cards, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment, crop, and background style across all restaurant thumbnails in the carousel.
